surat.headline: Surat cluster faces input-cost and labor shocks alongside localized demand pockets.
what_changed: Yarn prices surged significantly, triggering shutdown risks and early closure threats across looms and textile units [b567711c9ed4, 1b54f570ed7b, b62552cc0c7d].
Labor agitations and early Diwali migration caused temporary disruptions in weaving and embroidery segments [6b7974c7f88e, d6a4b0e6a74b, b0d8a5269e4e].
Diamond sector showed signs of resilience with a shortened vacation period and tech deployments, despite export shipment slumps [975918f112f3, 7eaa09c3357d, 2b47ff4fa01a].
stress_signals: Surat looms and textile units face early closure risks and margin pressures due to severe yarn price spikes [b567711c9ed4, 1b54f570ed7b, b62552cc0c7d].
Multiple payment defaults, fraud cases, and blacklisting of traders reported across yarn, fabric, and diamond segments [2514ad7d6e20, c4997bb35d98, a70c9ae52e8d, 2718cba9f837].
Worker agitations over leave, wages, and working hours driving a migrant worker exodus to UP and Bihar [6b7974c7f88e, d6a4b0e6a74b, a9383cbae2cf].
improvement_signals: Diamond industry shortened its traditional Diwali vacation for the first time in four years due to improved demand [2b47ff4fa01a].
MANTRA-trained entrepreneurs built ₹120 crore businesses as the cluster shifts towards technical textiles [7dc3005e0b28, a1f25f2b05a6].
what_to_watch: Monitor working capital utilization and inventory buildup among weaving units facing input cost shocks.
Track recovery status of defaulted trader accounts and legal disputes in the viscose and grey fabric segments.
Watch post-Diwali labor return rates and operational capacity normalization across embroidery and loom units.
